name: Rinkan Fukutoshin Sen ~Tomaranai Chikan Rensa~
original_name: 臨姦副都心線 ～止まらない痴漢連鎖～
source:
The act of making a person feel shame and anxiety in a public place, that is molestation.

The molestation was being carried out with impunity on the “Saikyo Line”. The act of molestation is rampant every day. Many female passengers are victims, their bodies at the mercy of their desires. Sometimes they even had sexual intercourse with each other.

To top it all off, there is still a legendary story about this kind of person. The most extreme case is the gang rape and molestation party, which is still called a legend and has become a story told by those who have been involved in such activities.

The group molestation involving many commuters was also a trigger for the crackdown on molestation.

The line was dubbed the “Rinkan Fukutoshin" Line.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/KRH-030/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
在公共场所使人感到羞耻和焦虑的行为，就是猥亵行为。

猥亵行为是在“埼京线”上进行而不受惩罚。猥亵行为每天都在猖獗。许多女性乘客都是受害者，她们的身体任由欲望摆布。有时他们甚至互相发生性行为。

最重要的是，关于这种人还有一个传奇故事。最极端的案例是轮奸猥亵聚会，至今仍被称为传奇，成为参与过此类活动的人的佳话。

此次涉及多名通勤者的集体猥亵事件，也是此次打击猥亵行为的导火索。

该线路被称为“Rinkan Fukutoshin”线。

[来自[url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/KRH-030/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
